reviewItem.question: Does "L7 network policy with terminatingTLS will not load the key `ca.crt` even if it is present in the secret" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cilium|name=terminatingtls-ca-crt-loading (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: In 1.16, L7 network policy with terminatingTLS no longer loads the ca.crt key from the secret, so Envoy no longer requires client certificates; set --use-full-tls-context=true to retain the old behaviour.
